image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (Blenheim color) lying on a textured beige surface against a blurred orange background. The dog is facing forward with large dark eyes, long feathered ears, and a white blaze on its forehead. The coat is white with chestnut/red patches.
